title: CSCI 262 — Introduction to Computer Science Theory
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define formal languages and automata as mathematical models for computation.
Explain how loop invariants and divide-and-conquer strategies structure algorithmic proofs.
Apply asymptotic notation and recurrence relations to analyze resource bounds of recursive algorithms.
